$comment: Hand-authored from Robot.configureBindings(). This is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the controls pages. Auto-generating it from the Java would be misleading: the LT/RT behaviour lives inside Commands.either(...) conditions, so the trigger expression alone understates what the robot does. A Gradle drift check verifies every pilot.X / operator.X referenced in configureBindings() appears here and vice versa.

controllers.name: Pilot
notes: Stick deadzone 0.10, exponential curve 3.0 on both sticks. Stick scalars are overwritten at runtime from the swerve's max speeds.

Driving is NOT a binding. Swerve has no default command; it reads the pilot sticks directly in calculateSpeedsBasedOnJoystickInputs() (Swerve.java:346-348), so drive never appears in configureBindings().

bindings.detail: Only when RT is not already held. Enters INTAKE_FUEL.
Only when LT is not already held. Enters LAUNCH_WITH_SQUEEZE.
Releasing RT restores the default feed target. If LT is still held it falls back to INTAKE_FUEL instead of idling.
Only when RT is held: releasing LT enters LAUNCH_WITH_SQUEEZE_WITH_NO_DELAY, skipping the squeeze wait.
Turret and hood aim at the hub without feeding. On release it idles unless already launching.
Runs everything backwards to clear a stuck ball. Idles on release.
Re-homes the intake extension. Requires LB NOT held, since LB+Select is the vision reset.

layers.name: LT held
layers.when: Left trigger held as a modifier

bindings.detail: LT + RT together launch while leaving the intake extended.
Releasing RT with LT still held returns to INTAKE_FUEL.

layers.name: LB held
layers.when: Left bumper held as a modifier

bindings.detail: Holds the drivetrain still through the shot. Idles when released.
Teleop only. Sets heading so the INTAKE points away from the driver. Rumbles to confirm.
Teleop only. D-pad direction is where the INTAKE points from the driver's view.
Teleop only.
Teleop only.
Works in ALL modes, not just disabled. Re-seeds the pose estimator from the turret camera. Prefer this over the D-pad reorient whenever tags are visible.
Lets you move the intake extension and turret by hand.
Re-engages brake mode after coasting.
Keyboard-friendly stand-in for RT.
Keyboard-friendly stand-in for LT. Note this collides with the real robot's disabled-mode brake binding.

controllers.name: Operator
notes: Trigger deadzone 0.0; everything else at Gamepad.Config defaults.

bindings.detail: Nudges ShotCalculator's HOOD_ANGLE_OFFSET. Persists until code restart. Works while disabled.
Shots going long? Come down. Works while disabled.
Nudges TURRET_ANGLE_OFFSET.
HELD, not pressed. Bypasses every shot-readiness gate and feeds anyway. This is not an onTrue binding — the trigger is handed to SuperStructure.setFeedOverride() as a live condition.
Releasing either bumper restores the default feed target.
Same as pilot A.

Point the turret away from the intake BY HAND first, then press. The turret no longer zeroes itself on code start, so this is how the zero gets set. Check Turret/PositionDegrees reads near 0 afterwards.
